name: Oil (lamp oil)
notes: Lamp and cooking oil as a spilled puddle or a filled flask: the classic oil-slick fire starter. Ignites at 210 °C (bead note) and a puddle burns for 60 s. Density 900 kg/m³, so it floats on water and a burning slick can spread across it. Very slippery (0.1). Thickens only well below freezing (−20 °C). Muffled, slick footsteps (−2 dB). A burning puddle is consumed (mw-e03.5: destroyed). A liquid (it pools, and a pool's top can be a waterSurface); soft surface. (mw-e03.31)
